mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (kakao_id, nickname, profile_img) VALUES (#{kakaoId}, #{nickname}, #{profileImg})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_level SET streak = CASE WHEN last_attend_dt = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN streak + 1 ELSE 1 END, last_attend_dt = CURDATE() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (last_attend_dt IS NULL OR last_attend_dt < CURDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT streak FROM user_level WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_img, ul.points, ul.level, ul.streak, COUNT(qr.result_id) AS total_solved, SUM(CASE WHEN qr.is_correct = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_level ul ON u.user_id = ul.user_id LEFT JOIN quiz_result qr ON u.user_id = qr.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_img, ul.points, ul.level, ul.streak
